preconditions.description: Input size n and exponent k are at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input array a are positive integers between 1 and 10^5.
The input array a has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if any((a[i] * a[j]) == x**k for x in range(1, int((a[i] * a[j])**0.5) + 1))))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all pairs (i, j) where 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n and there exists an integer x such that a[i] * a[j] = x^k.
